title: Small Group Manatee Discovery Kayak Tour near Orlando
includes: Premium sit-on-top kayak, paddle & life jacket
Transportation to the meeting location (not included)
Guide gratuities (optional, but always appreciated) (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Please arrive 30 minutes before your scheduled tour time.
Wear quick-dry clothing and water shoes or sandals.
Bring sun protection, including sunscreen, sunglasses, and a hat.
Bring a towel and a change of clothes for after your tour.

There are no restroom facilities at the meeting location. The nearest public restrooms are located at Valentine Park (1511 W French Ave, Orange City, FL 32763), approximately one mile before the meeting location.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Blue Spring State Park, one of Florida's premier destinations for observing wild manatees, on a small-group wildlife tour led by expert naturalist guides. Our small-group tours create a more personal and immersive experience, allowing guests to observe wildlife while learning about the ecology, wildlife behavior, and unique freshwater habitats of Blue Spring State Park through expert naturalist interpretation. While manatees are the highlight, every tour offers the opportunity to experience the remarkable diversity of native wildlife that makes Blue Spring State Park one of Florida's most unique freshwater ecosystems. Designed for all skill levels, this beginner-friendly experience combines expert interpretation with an authentic connection to Florida's wild places. Every tour follows ethical wildlife viewing practices that prioritize the well-being of the animals while creating authentic, meaningful encounters in nature.
